content:
maya: heads-up — noticed a sharp spike in billed tokens for tenant `acme-corp` around 03:12 UTC, invoice preview shows duplicate events
eli: saw the alert in the console too, +18% usage spike in 5m window :grimacing:
maya: digging in ingest logs — looks like the same event_id was emitted twice with different routing metadata
jonathan: do we have traces that tie event_id -> route_id? traces in console don't link the two emissions cleanly
ashley: route-resolver might be 'bubbling' route tags on fallback and re-emitting. that could mutate the fingerprint used for dedupe
metering-bot: ingest: 1727777777 duplicate_event detected route_bubble=true (auto-flagged)
sam: can you paste a log snippet?
maya: sure, sample logs:
```
INFO 03:12:01 event_id=ev_abc route=route-a fingerprint=fp123 emitted
INFO 03:12:02 route-resolver DUP emit route=route-a->route-b fingerprint=fp123
INFO 03:12:03 ingest accepted event_id=ev_abc shard=7
```
eli: that route-a->route-b pattern indicates we append route history (x-route-history) instead of normalizing it
jonathan: if fingerprint includes route_history as-is, order/duplicates will change the hash -> double-count
maya: confirmed — fingerprint calc currently does join(sorted(headers.route_history)) in some code paths and join(raw) in others (fun)
ashley: oof. inconsistency across services. one service sorts, another doesn't. devops nightmare
sam: quick fix idea: make fingerprint canonical by deduping route entries and sorting before hashing, or better: derive fp from stable attributes only (tenant, model, request_id)
eli: prefer stable-attributes approach. route history is mutable and shouldn't affect accounting. we need a migration for recent dupes though
jonathan: dashboard/tracing follow-up: when route_history length >1 we drop the trace-link in the preview UI — that made root cause harder to find
maya: proxy sometimes strips x-correlation so traces don't stitch. we should ensure proxies pass x-request-id through to ingest
sam: I can add header passthrough to the edge proxy today (PR in progress)
ashley: rollout plan proposal:
- patch route-resolver to stop appending duplicate entries
- hotfix ingest fingerprint to canonicalize (backwards-compatible tolerant dedupe for 48h)
- reconciliation job to collapse duplicates for last 48h and adjust invoice previews
jonathan: add alert that surfaces when fingerprint-variance rate > 0.1% per tenant (so we catch regressions)
eli: for recon job: group by stable_fp (new algorithm) and reduce token count by dedup factor, record audit log for invoice ops
metering-bot: scheduled job "billing-reconcile-172777" queued for 2024-04-12T07:00:00Z
maya: action items: sam -> proxy header passthrough PR, ashley -> route-resolver patch, eli -> PR for stable-fp calc, jonathan -> dashboard + alert, maya -> coordinate invoice ops & finance
ashley: rough impact estimate: ~120 tenants with small double-bills, ballpark refund exposure ~$2.1k if we need to adjust invoices
sam: starting proxy PR, will ping when staging runs green
maya: thanks. cc @finance FYI :wave:
finance: thanks for the ping, please include estimated tenant list and rough $ impact when you have it
maya: will follow up in this thread with the checklist and tenant export
eli: one more note — add a unit test that simulates route_history re-ordering and asserts stable_fp unchanged
jonathan: and add a tracing link header everywhere: `x-trace-id` -> ingest -> metering pipeline
maya: good call. I'll draft a short playbook for on-call to run the reconcile job if alerts spike
ashley: will open the resolver PR after lunch
maya: thanks team — we should be able to contain this without a broad rollback
